writer_preview.character_count_note: Exact Unicode code-point count was not available through the GitHub connector; UTF-8 byte size is recorded instead and this missing metric is retained as an explicit dry-run warning rather than estimated.

quality_findings.finding: Autodesk cumulative release notes caused a false freshness attribution: a 7/17 natural-language bulk-editing entry and a different Intent Driven Design section were summarized as an August 17 signal.
quality_findings.disposition: Curator rejected the candidate after opening the source and checking section context.
quality_findings.lesson: Date plausibility validation is insufficient for cumulative changelog pages; semantic section-date association must be checked before selection.

quality_findings.finding: The first dry-run Scout artifacts were written with generated_at values later than the actual wall clock.
quality_findings.disposition: The error was detected before curation and both artifacts were corrected and re-committed.
quality_findings.lesson: Generated timestamps must come from the execution environment, not be projected manually.

quality_findings.finding: The first company rotation was dominated by CAD/CAE vendors, producing fewer aerospace-engine OEM signals than the intended long-run topic balance.
quality_findings.disposition: Accepted for this run because watchlist rotation is stateful; evaluate balance over a full rotation rather than one day.
quality_findings.lesson: Daily composition should not be forced, but weekly coverage should be measured.

quality_findings.finding: The collector repository reports zero GitHub Actions workflow runs, and the newly added dry-run validation workflow did not auto-execute on push.
quality_findings.disposition: A dry-run CI workflow and scripts/validate_dry_run.py were committed, but CI status is recorded as not_executed rather than falsely marked passed.
quality_findings.lesson: Collector Actions availability/settings must be confirmed before relying on CI as the deterministic gate.

validator_status.note: The production article validator rules were read from naoyamd/daily-signal and the preview was built to those rules. The collector-side CI intended to execute both validators did not run, so this evaluation does not claim an executed CI pass.

recommendations: Add a source-page pattern rule or Curator check for cumulative release notes/changelogs so item dates must be associated with the exact section that supports the claim.
Record weekly topic coverage across a full company-watch rotation; do not compensate a CAD/CAE-heavy day by inventing unrelated aerospace items.
Confirm or enable GitHub Actions for naoyamd/daily-signal-collector, then require the dry-run workflow to pass before calling future runs fully validated.

Keep the current split: Scout preserves recall, Curator performs semantic date/evidence checks, Writer preserves claim density. The dry run found a real error specifically because these roles were separated.
warnings: No article was written to naoyamd/daily-signal/content/daily and no publication receipt/index was modified.
Exact article_character_count is unavailable; UTF-8 byte size is recorded without estimating a false value.
CI was not executed; validator pass is not asserted beyond rule-level preflight.
